summary.text: Mark Racic is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as retired; in a survey he described himself as a lifelong Strafford County resident living in Milton.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Racic said he is a retired lifelong Strafford County resident who moved to a more rural lake community in Milton.
He listed housing costs and the supply of entry-level housing, property taxes, and school budgets and governance among his campaign messages.
He also named protecting the family and supporting women among his policy interests.
